name: level-editor
description: In-game level editor: an Edit run mode over the real pipeline — scene round-trip, selection, bounded undo/redo, transform gizmo (move/rotate/scale + grid-snap), an engine-native toolbar, and a headless editor-op channel for testing
postInstallNotes:
## level-editor module installed

The in-game editor stands on the run-state model in `foundation` (`GameState.RunMode` Play/Edit + `EditTimeBehavior` + the `GatedSystem` decorator) and the docs codifying "the editor is part of the game" (`docs/CORE_TENETS.md` tenet + a `foundation` run-state premise).

Live today: the scene round-trip (`SceneObjectComponent`, `Serialization/` registry + `SceneWriter`, `LoadSceneRequest` + `SceneReaderSystem`), selection (`SelectedComponent` + `SelectionSystem`, picking the frontmost sprite), bounded undo/redo with drag-coalescing (`Undo/` — `EditorHistory`, `IEditorCommand`, create/delete/transform commands), the transform gizmo (`GizmoSystem` + `GizmoStateComponent` + the pure `Transform/GizmoTransform` math — move/rotate/scale handles, a selection outline, grid-snap, drag → one undo step), the engine-native toolbar (`ToolbarSystem` + `UI/EditorToolbarBuilder` — tool-select/Save/Load/Undo/Redo/snap on the HUD target), and the headless editor-op channel (`Channel/EditorOpPlan` + `Channel/EditorOpReplaySystem` + the `CursorInputSystem.SkipHardwareRead` seam — drives the real editor systems with no real mouse). See `docs/level-editor/roadmap.md` for the wave map and plug-in points.

To opt a screen into editing: wrap the game-logic / physics / camera-follow systems in `GatedSystem(child, EditTimeBehavior.Freeze)`, keep render / input / cursor / `HierarchySystem` ungated (or `RunNormally`), register the editor systems (`SelectionSystem`, `EditorModeToggleSystem`, `EditorCommandSystem`, `SceneReaderSystem`, `GizmoSystem`, `ToolbarSystem`) RunNormally + Edit-guarded, create one shared `EditorHistory` + one `GizmoStateComponent` entity, and flip `gameState.RunMode` to enter/exit Edit with no screen swap. The reference assembly is `MonoDreams.Examples.Core/Screens/LevelEditorScreen.cs`; the full system-by-mode policy is the interaction matrix in `docs/CORE_TENETS.md`.
